recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12190 unless a later work group decision intentionally changes the HTTP create response header rule.
issue_request: FHIR-12190 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core and requested changing the RESTful create response Location header from SHOULD to SHALL so clients would not need to inspect both Location and Content-Location.
initial_application: Commit 3d7763fc7d0a1a1921562cf73de46c53197d669e, corresponding to the Jira comment svn @10126, explicitly mentioned #12190 and changed the create response wording in source/http.html from SHOULD to SHALL for the Location header.
additional_context: Current source/http.html still requires Location for successful create and separately documents Content-Location only for the async pattern. Later FHIR-26358 extended mandatory Location-header behavior to conditional create/update contexts, and found Zulip discussion supported Location rather than Content-Location for this use.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active RESTful API source already satisfies the issue and bounded searches found no conflicting create-response SHOULD language.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue extended mandatory Location-header behavior to conditional create/update cases without reversing FHIR-12190.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue requested changing the create response Location header from SHOULD to SHALL.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final seed decision and establishes the target conformance language.

evidence_items.summary: The current RESTful create section says a successful create returns 201 Created and SHALL also return a Location header.
evidence_items.learned: The active HTTP source already satisfies FHIR-12190.

evidence_items.summary: The current HTTP header table documents Location for create/upsert and Content-Location for the async pattern.
evidence_items.learned: The current source distinguishes the two headers and does not preserve the ambiguity raised by the issue.

evidence_items.summary: The 2016 commit explicitly mentioning #12190 changed the create response text from SHOULD to SHALL for Location.
evidence_items.learned: The original application matches the Jira resolution.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue later made Location mandatory for related conditional create/update responses.
evidence_items.learned: Later same-family history reinforces, rather than reverses, the Location-header requirement.

evidence_items.summary: A 2017 thread asked whether FHIR should use Content-Location instead of Location; Grahame Grieve responded that the spec was not using it wrong.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community discussion contradicts the Location-header choice.

evidence_items.command: rg -n 'Resource has been created successfully|location header should|Location header should|Content-Location|successful create.*Location|create.*Location header' source -g '*.html'; rg -n 'Content-Location|Location header should|SHOULD also return a Location|server SHOULD return a Location' source
evidence_items.summary: Search found the mandatory create Location rule, a non-conflicting overview example, the HTTP header table, and only specificity-oriented 'Location header should be as specific as possible' text.
evidence_items.learned: There is no stale create-response SHOULD that requires a source fix.
